integrity: The general opacity reduction is attributed to Allouche–Yao; the shortest-path minimization, all-radix formula, and exact level multiplicities are proved in RESULT.md. Numerical path tests corroborate but are not used as infinite proofs. No independent validation is claimed.
limitations: Applies only to injectively labeled residue periods and the prefix metric; does not treat noninjective periodic codings or quadratic-semimetric opacity. The complete 2026 journal revision is not openly inspectable from its preview.
title: Exact radix–period opacity and level spectrum for residue clocks
